:::{#thm-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group}
#### Likelihood of binary outcomes with one event probability

Let $Y_i \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $i = 1, \dots, n$, and $\vy \eqdef (\dsn{y})$.
The likelihood of $\vy$ depends on the data only through the number of events:

$$\Lik(\prob; \vy) = \prob^{\sumin y_i} (1 - \prob)^{n - \sumin y_i}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group.

:::
